name: shridhar-stock
description: Stock for the shop: items, units, places, godowns, transfers, and the website for workers, godowns, vendors, delivery and customers. Separate from the billing app, which it only reads.

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build --workspace @stock/server && npm run build --workspace @stock/web
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:core && npm run dev --workspace @stock/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run unittest && npm run schematest && npm run apitest && npm run roletest && npm run linktest
